purpose: Single source of truth for the FaultDA current-evidence acceptance job. .github/workflows/faultda-current.yml must invoke `python -m faultda_bench.current_evidence` and must not inline any tests.test_faultda_ module list.

discovery.policy: Every file matching glob under root appears exactly once in test_modules or in excluded. A file in neither fails tests/test_faultda_current_evidence.py::RegistryCompletenessTests.
